def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # A line of 5s links a colored pattern at one end to an opposite bar;
    # extend the pattern across the perpendicular axis marked by the bar.
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==5]
    rs={r for r,c in pts}; cs={c for r,c in pts}
    if len(rs)==1:
        rline=next(iter(rs)); cmin=min(cs); cmax=max(cs)
        # colored pattern at right of the connector; replicate it upward/downward
        cols=[c for c in range(w) if g[rline][c] not in (0,5)]
        if cols:
            colors=[g[rline][c] for c in cols]
            anchor=max(rs)
            for r in range(h):
                if r==rline: continue
                for c,color in zip(cols,colors):
                    if g[r][c]==0: g[r][c]=color
    elif len(cs)==1:
        cline=next(iter(cs))
        # find colored seed row alongside vertical connector, replicate horizontally
        rows=[r for r in range(h) if g[r][cline] not in (0,5)]
        if rows:
            rseed=rows[0]
            # preserve ordered nonzero seed cells immediately to right of connector
            seed=[g[rseed][c] for c in range(cline+1,w) if g[rseed][c] not in (0,5)]
            for r in range(h):
                if r==rseed: continue
                for i,color in enumerate(seed):
                    c=cline+1+i
                    if c<w and g[r][c]==0: g[r][c]=color
    return g

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Find straight 5 connector, and the colored stripe attached perpendicular to it.
    five=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==5]
    rs={r for r,c in five}; cs={c for r,c in five}
    if len(cs)==1:
        c=next(iter(cs))
        # The non-5 colored stripe on the same boundary row is the pattern to copy.
        seed=next(r for r in range(h) if any(g[r][j] not in (0,5) for j in range(c+1,w)))
        pattern=[g[seed][j] for j in range(c+1,w) if g[seed][j] not in (0,5)]
        start=c+1
        for r in range(h):
            if r==seed: continue
            for i,v in enumerate(pattern):
                if start+i<w: g[r][start+i]=v
    elif len(rs)==1:
        r=next(iter(rs))
        seed=next(c for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0,5))
        # stripe at row r copied along the vertical 5 segment
        pattern=[]
        for c in range(seed,w):
            if g[r][c] not in (0,5): pattern.append(g[r][c])
        for rr in range(h):
            for i,v in enumerate(pattern):
                if seed+i<w: g[rr][seed+i]=v
    return g

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    five=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==5]
    rs={r for r,c in five}; cs={c for r,c in five}
    # Cross-shaped guides: extend colored side-patterns into the blank sectors.
    # Horizontal color marks on the left expand across the open horizontal arm.
    if len(rs)>1 and len(cs)>1:
        left=min(cs); right=max(cs)
        for r in range(min(rs)+1,max(rs)):
            v=g[r][0]
            if v not in (0,5):
                for c in range(1,left): g[r][c]=v
        # The two-row colored tile at the bottom repeats up the vertical arm.
        seed=max(r for r in range(h) if any(g[r][c] not in (0,5) for c in range(right+1,w)))
        patrows=[]
        for r in range(seed-1,seed+1):
            patrows.append([g[r][c] for c in range(right+1,w) if g[r][c] not in (0,5)])
        for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1):
            if r in (seed-1,seed): continue
            vals=patrows[(seed-r)%2]
            for i,v in enumerate(vals):
                g[r][right+1+i]=v
    return g

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # 5 forms two crossing guides. Colored stripes at the ends tile inward
    # along each guide: left colors fill the horizontal arm, right pattern
    # alternates down the vertical arm.
    five=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==5]
    rs={r for r,c in five}; cs={c for r,c in five}
    if len(rs)>1 and len(cs)>1:
        lo,hi=min(rs),max(rs); left,right=min(cs),max(cs)
        for r in range(lo+1,hi):
            v=g[r][0]
            if v not in (0,5):
                for c in range(1,left): g[r][c]=v
        upper=[g[hi-1][c] for c in range(right+1,w) if g[hi-1][c] not in (0,5)]
        lower=[g[hi][c] for c in range(right+1,w) if g[hi][c] not in (0,5)]
        for r in range(lo,hi+1):
            pat=upper if (hi-r)%2==1 else lower
            for i,v in enumerate(pat):
                if right+1+i<w: g[r][right+1+i]=v
    return g

    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])

    # Repeat the two-row endpoint motif up the vertical arm of the guide.
